officialPages.text:
# Become a supplier

Registration and qualification requirements and processes.

All companies supplying goods and services to Aramco are required to be registered.

There are different registration and qualification processes and requirements depending on a number of factors, such as the supplier company's location and type (material vendor, manufacturer, or service provider). Aramco is looking for high-performing and highly-qualified suppliers who can provide best-in-class materials and services.

It is important to note that registering and then qualifying as an Aramco supplier does not guarantee you future business with Aramco.

Registration requirements

## Our ‘Doing Business with Aramco’ guide

This guide provides suppliers with the necessary, basic information on how to do business with Aramco, covering supplier registration, qualification, the iktva program, and our procurement policies.

To download the Doing Business with Aramco guide, please click here.

### Suppliers based in Saudi Arabia

Aramco's Dhahran office is responsible for the registration of companies located in Saudi Arabia (In-Kingdom). Any company interested in doing business with Aramco must register as a supplier through our e-Marketplace Platform. Saudi Arabia based companies can submit a request for registration to become a supplier for Aramco by accessing the link below.

In-Kingdom based supplier registration.

For additional guidance on how to register with Aramco, including submitting a registration questionnaire through the Aramco e-Marketplace Platform, please read our Supplier Registration Technical Guide and watch the video tutorials below.

### Suppliers based in the GCC and the wider Middle East

Aramco’s Dhahran office additionally handles supplier registration for companies located in the following GCC and Middle East nations:

GCC — United Arab Emirates, Bahrain, Kuwait, Oman, and Qatar.

Middle East — Iraq, Jordan, Syria, Egypt, and Lebanon.

Suppliers based in these countries are also required to register through our e-Marketplace Platform via the link below.

GCC and Middle East supplier registration.

## International Suppliers

### Suppliers based in Africa

Management of suppliers located in **Kenya** and **Somalia** is by our Dhahran office.

Suppliers located in these two African nations should register with our Dhahran Suppliers Team using the e-Marketplace Platform link below.

Kenya and Somalia-based supplier registration

Prospective suppliers based in **all other African nations** are required to visit our international suppliers page via the link below.

International suppliers

### Suppliers based in Asia

Management of suppliers located in **Afghanistan**, **Bangladesh,** and **Pakistan** is by our Dhahran office.

Suppliers located in these countries need to register with our Dhahran Suppliers Team using the e-Marketplace Platform link below.

Prospective suppliers based in **all other Asian nations** are required to visit our international suppliers page via the link below.

International suppliers

### All other nations

Companies seeking to do business with Aramco based in all other geographies (countries not already listed above) must communicate with the appropriate Aramco affiliated company — Aramco Americas (Houston, U.S.), Aramco Europe (AEC – Amsterdam, the Netherlands), or Aramco Asia Company (AAC) — located in their region.

The relevant Aramco affiliate company will evaluate the information provided and determine whether there is a business need for the registration of additional materials or services. Any further evaluation will depend on whether the supplier is deemed financially and technically acceptable. International suppliers who demonstrate that their materials or services offer significant technical or commercial benefit to the company will be further considered.

To register as a prospective supplier, please contact the Aramco affiliated company corresponding to your location.

Affiliate contact information

### In-Kingdom Total Value Add (IKTVA) Program

Our In-Kingdom Total Value Add (iktva) program is designed to drive supply-chain efficiency and value across our operations, and to encourage the development of a diverse, and globally competitive energy sector in Saudi Arabia.

Find out more

### 

## Registration requirements

Below are the registration requirements that need to be met by any Saudi Arabia based supplier (materials or services) interested in registering as a supplier with Aramco.

**Government requirements**:

* A valid copy of the Commercial Registration (CR) Certificate
* A valid copy of the Industrial License (manufacturers only)
* A valid copy of the Investment License (if applicable)
* A valid copy of the Zakat Certificate
* A valid copy of the Value Added Tax (VAT) Certificate
* A valid copy of the General Organization for Social Insurance (GOSI) Certificate
* A valid copy of the Civil Defense License or an equivalent Government License
* A valid copy of the Chamber of Commerce & Industry Membership Certificate
* Contractor Government Classification, if applicable (service providers only)

**Aramco requirements**:

* Original acknowledgement of Aramco's Suppliers Code of Conduct
* A letter from the bank with which the company is dealing, stating the type of service that the bank normally provides to your company and relationship status
* A valid Company Ownership Profile with required supporting documents
* Authorized Signatory Letter identifying the Authorized Company Employees dealing with Aramco
* A valid copy of the Jadeer certificate issued by Monsha’at’ if applicable (Small and Medium Enterprises only)
* A valid copy of Cybersecurity Compliance Certificate (CCC)

****\*Note, the above requirements are not applicable to suppliers based outside of Saudi Arabia (GCC and wider Middle East or International suppliers).****

### Supplier resources

Important documents and useful information for Aramco suppliers.

Find out more

### Value Added Tax

As of January 1, 2018, Value Added Tax (VAT) was implemented in Saudi Arabia, in accordance with the Framework Agreement between the Gulf Cooperation Council for the Arab States (GCC).

Find out more

### Out of Kingdom suppliers

As a leading global, integrated energy and chemicals company with operations and projects around the world, our work calls for quality products and services, everywhere we do business. Trusted international manufacturers, material vendors, and service providers help us meet those needs.

Find out more

### Contact information

If you require assistance with your registration or access to our portal you can contact our Helpdesk.

Find out more

officialPages.text:
Seize the opportunity to become a part of Saudi Arabia's ambitious future

Integrated capabilities driving excellence across every destination

Powering the Kingdom’s new destinations and beyond

The world’s most ambitious regenerative tourism destination

Creating opportunities for people and protecting nature as we build a thriving, sustainable economy.

Over a Thousand Talents Transforming the Future of Saudi Arabia’s Tourism

Red Sea Global media center provides the latest news, updates and industry insights from The Red Sea.

Seize the opportunity to become a part of Saudi Arabia's ambitious future

At Red Sea Global, we believe that successful partnerships are built on a clear understanding of sustainable values and integrated collaboration, supported by effective governance. In line with Saudi Vision 2030, we are committed to transforming tourism and strengthening the Kingdom’s global presence through partnerships that value innovation, balance responsibility, and drive long-term growth.

Collaborate on world-class projects that redefine luxury, sustainability, and design.

Be part of a partnership built on fairness, accountability, and open collaboration.

Access a growing portfolio of iconic destinations and long-term business potential.

Championing Local Content in Saudi Arabia

RSG is deeply committed to fostering local content as a cornerstone of Saudi Arabia’s Vision 2030, driving economic diversification and empowering the Kingdom’s workforce and industries. By prioritizing partnerships with Saudi-based suppliers, RSG ensures that a significant portion of our spend remains within the local economy, supporting job creation and skills development.By embedding local content requirements into our key processes, RSG creates lasting opportunities for small and medium enterprises (SMEs) and builds a resilient supply chain that aligns with national priorities for sustainable growth and self-reliance.

Register your interest as a supplier

Fill Out the Form:

Share your core business details and select the categories that best showcase the excellence of your products or services.

Submit Your Request:

After submission, you will receive an instant confirmation message as we begin reviewing your profile for potential opportunities.

Our Next Step:

Our team will carefully evaluate your information, and we will contact you directly as soon as suitable opportunities align with your expertise.

Thank you!

Your request is submitted.

RSG regularly reviews the information provided. When suitable opportunities arise that align with your capabilities, we will contact you to proceed with the formal vendor registration process.

Suppliers have a duty and personal commitment to uphold our common ideals, as set out in our Code of Conduct, which enables us to continue to prosper while keeping our reputation of a high standard of integrity and ethics.

The Code of Conduct contains policies that relate to the legal and ethical standards of conduct that suppliers are expected to comply with while carrying out their fiduciary duties and responsibilities to us.

This Code is intended to help suppliers focus on areas of ethical risk, provide guidance to recognize and deal with ethical issues, provide mechanisms to report unethical conduct, and help foster a culture of honesty and accountability.

As part of a vendor’s registration process, we require you to sign and return the Code.

Please note: pre-qualification is not a guarantee of future business with RSG.

To become an RSG supplier, the first step is to register your interest by completing the “Register Your Interest” form. RSG continually reviews the profiles of potential suppliers to identify potential opportunities for them to participate in. Where we do find an opportunity that matches your capabilities, we will reach out to you to progress with a more formal process to register your company as a Supplier.

It takes just a few minutes to Register Your Interest for RSG review. If we contact you to complete formal registration it will typically take approximately one week.

Registered and qualified companies automatically receive tenders for their specific category.

Registered suppliers gain access to RSG’s planned procurement pipeline. Be aware that this pipeline may change.

A physical presence in Saudi Arabia is not always necessary, depending on the service provided. However, having an agent or office in the Kingdom could be advantageous. There's no requirement for potential partners to be partly or fully owned by a Saudi national or entity.

RSG welcomes companies from around the world, including those without prior experience in the Kingdom or region. However, international experience is preferred.

While materials produced in the Kingdom are preferable, RSG recognizes that some products, equipment, and materials can only be produced outside the region.

RSG does not charge fees to receive or participate in its tenders. In most cases, vendors are not required to submit tender bonds.

# Join the global supplier network in NEOM

Register now



Sign in

* ## Building the future together

  Become a supplier at NEOM and share our vision to accelerate human progress. NEOM is looking to team up with world-leading companies across all industries to collaborate on our mission to redefine livability, conservation and business.

## Partner with NEOM in 3 simple steps

* ### Apply online

  Register through our supplier portal – it’s quick, free and open to any company that shares our vision and values.
* ### Complete profile

  Submit your company details and supporting documents and accept our terms. Once approved, you’ll receive a supplier questionnaire to fill out.
* ### Participate in tenders

  Once selected, you’ll gain access to NEOM’s procurement opportunities and be invited to participate in relevant tenders.

## Key Benefits

At NEOM, we’re committed to making your onboarding journey and partnership experience as seamless as possible. This is why we have created a set of tools and resources to support you, including a dedicated supplier platform, online guides and live webinars.

Suppliers Portal

Active with NEOM since its inception, with more than 30 ongoing projects, we are proud to partner with this great vision. We take pride and honor in supporting NEOM with our advanced solutions and commitment to efficiency and reliability. We are passionately driven to make a difference and support the Kingdom’s Vision 2030 by making the impossible possible. The level of our business relationship with NEOM is beyond borders accompanied by transparency, ethics, responsibility, professionalism, and teamwork.
  >

# Vendor Gate - Be Part of Our Vendor Network.

Become a vendor

## Why Partner with Diriyah Company?

### Trusted Partnerships

At Diriyah Company, we value strong, reliable relationships with our vendors. We are committed to ensuring transparency, quality, and professional execution across every stage of our work. Our partners are essential contributors to realizing the Diriyah Company vision, and we strive to build long-term collaborations based on trust and shared success.

## Vendor Categories:

* Design and Engineering Services
* Technical Services
* Site Preparation and Enabling Works
* Infrastructure Works
* Construction Material and Equipment
* Furniture, Fixture and Equipment (FF&E)
* Building Works
* Renovation and Restoration
* Professional Services
* Technology
* Mobility Services
* Asset Management
* Insurance
* Human Capital Services
* Admin Services
* Marketing
* Arts & Heritage

## How to register

Stage 1

### Request for registration process

First click on "Become a Vendor", then fill in the information and submit. Diriyah Company will then review the request.

Stage 2

### Registration process

The registration questionnaires will reach the vendor for them to fill in and submit, then Diriyah Company will review the submitted vendor registration.

Stage 3

### Qualification process

Diriyah Company will send qualification questionnaires to the vendor based on the categories selected during the registration process; the vendor then needs to fill in the required information Diriyah Company will then review the support documents and approve if we have no further comments.

Stage 1

Stage 2

Stage 3

Vendor support email

For any questions or support, contact us at [email protected]

## Registration and Qualification FAQ

### I am already a registered vendor with Diriyah Company. Do I need to register again?

Yes.

However, please use your current registration login details to update your current version of the questionnaire. There are additional questions that need answering and certificates that are required. If your registration is not compliant for over 3 months, Diriyah Company may have to deactivate your profile

### I am a registered vendor with Diriyah Gate Development Authority (DGDA). Can I use the same profile to work with Diriyah Company?

No.

DGDA and Diriyah Company are different entities with separate platforms and registration processes. If you want to continue with DGDA only, then there is no need to register with Diriyah Company.

### I was sent an email from [email protected] – is this spam?

No.

This is the Vendor Relations Management official email inbox. Please read any information from us carefully and feel free to reach out with any additional questions.

### We have already registered, but we have not received any RFPs yet. What should we do?

Vendors are invited as per the categories specified in the vendor registration questionnaires; you can revise your responses by specifying additional categories within your scope.

### I represent an international company but I am signing up on behalf of our Saudi branch. Shall I select “local” or “international” for vendor type?

Local.

Any vendors registering with a Saudi Commercial Registration should select “local” when specifying vendor type.

additionalOfficialPages.text:
Supplier Prequalification

# Vendor & Supplier Registration for PSFM Saudi Arabia

Submit your company profile for PSFM review. Registration does not guarantee approval or contract award.

1. **Submit profile**Company details and documents
2. **Team review**Our team reviews your submission
3. **Follow-up if relevant**When there is a potential fit

Supplier & Vendor Form

## Supplier & Vendor Profile Submission

Registration scope and preparation guidance

Register your company for PSFM supplier prequalification and category matching. PSFM reviews vendor profiles for facility management, manpower, cleaning, maintenance, MEP, logistics, materials, equipment, and workwear support requirements across Saudi Arabia. Registration does not guarantee approval or contract award.

Complete the form below with accurate company, contact, service scope, coverage, CR, VAT, capacity, and supporting document information available today. Submission does not guarantee approval or contract award; it allows PSFM to review your supplier profile when relevant requirements arise.

Supplier guidance, documents and coverage

**Category Matching**
Profiles are reviewed against PSFM service categories, operational needs, and Saudi coverage requirements.

**Document Review**
Company profile, CR certificate, bank/IBAN proof, Saudization certificate, owner ID, and optional VAT certificate help the procurement review.

**No Automatic Approval**
Submission allows review only; it does not confirm approval, onboarding, purchase order, or contract award.

Supplier Categories

## Supplier categories PSFM may review

PSFM may review suppliers and service partners that support facility operations, manpower readiness, technical work, materials, logistics, and project delivery across Saudi Arabia.

### Facility & Maintenance Support

Facility management, building maintenance, MEP coordination, HVAC, electrical, plumbing, and civil works support suppliers.

### Manpower & Site Services

Manpower supply, cleaning teams, housekeeping staff, site support labour, logistics support, and project workforce partners.

### Materials, Equipment & Workwear

Consumables, tools, equipment, uniforms, workwear, safety items, and operational supply support vendors.

Who Should Register

## Who should register as a PSFM supplier

The vendor form is intended for companies that can support PSFM client operations with reliable service delivery, clear documentation, and Saudi market readiness.

* **Saudi service suppliers**
  Companies with operating capacity in Jeddah, Riyadh, Dammam, Khobar, Makkah, or other Saudi service coverage areas.
* **Specialist service partners**
  Suppliers with practical capability in FM, manpower, cleaning, technical maintenance, materials, logistics, or project support.
* **Document-ready vendors**
  Companies able to share CR, VAT, profile, contact details, and additional compliance documents when requested.

Review Process

## How PSFM reviews supplier registrations

The process is a structured supplier-prequalification review. It helps PSFM understand category fit, documentation status, service coverage, and potential operational relevance.

* **Submit Supplier Profile**
  Share company details, service category, operating cities, core capability, and available supporting documents.
* **Category and Document Review**
  PSFM reviews the profile against service category fit, coverage, documentation, and active operational requirements.
* **Follow-up When Relevant**
  If the supplier profile fits a current or future requirement, PSFM may contact the vendor for clarification or quotation discussion.

Documents

## Documents that support vendor review

Upload only the available files requested in the form. Additional documents such as GOSI, Zakat, Saudization, MISA, insurance, safety documents, or project references may be requested later if relevant.

### Company Profile

Recommended summary of company services, operating cities, manpower capacity, experience, and contact details.

Recommended

### Commercial Registration

Optional CR certificate upload helps confirm company registration details during review.

Optional upload

### VAT Certificate

Optional VAT certificate upload supports supplier documentation completeness where applicable.

Optional upload

**Additional Saudi compliance documents:**
The current public form requires company profile, CR certificate, bank account/IBAN proof, Saudization certificate, and owner ID uploads. VAT certificate is optional where applicable. Other Saudi compliance, capacity, insurance, safety, and project-reference documents remain review guidance unless PSFM requests them later.

Arabic Support

## دعم تسجيل الموردين باللغة العربية

يمكن للموردين ومزودي الخدمات تسجيل بياناتهم لدى PSFM لمراجعة الملاءمة ضمن فئات إدارة المرافق، القوى العاملة، التنظيف، الصيانة، أعمال MEP، الخدمات اللوجستية، المواد، المعدات، والزي الموحد داخل المملكة العربية السعودية. التسجيل لا يعني الموافقة أو منح عقد، بل يتيح مراجعة الملف عند وجود متطلبات مناسبة.

Supplier Readiness

## What PSFM Reviews Before Supplier Shortlisting

PSFM reviews supplier category, service scope, coverage, documents, team readiness, and safety and quality alignment before moving a supplier into evaluation.

### Scope Review

Confirm service type, city, facility type, operating hours, and priority before pricing.

### Manpower Planning

Review roles, quantity, contract duration, and the right mobilization model for the site.

### Supervision & Quality

Clarify supervision needs, reporting rhythm, and quality standards for daily operations.

### Safety & Access

Consider safety requirements, access controls, and worksite conditions before service starts.

Vendor FAQ

## Vendor registration questions

These answers clarify how PSFM reviews supplier submissions and what vendors should prepare.

Does registration guarantee vendor approval?

No. Registration allows PSFM to review your supplier profile. It does not guarantee approval, onboarding, purchase order, or contract award.

Which documents are required?

The form asks for company and contact details. Company profile, CR certificate, and VAT certificate are optional uploads that can support the review. Additional documents may be requested later if relevant.

Can suppliers outside Jeddah register?

Yes. PSFM has its real head office in Al Faisaliyyah, Jeddah, and reviews suppliers with service coverage in Saudi cities where operational support may be needed.

When will PSFM contact a vendor?

PSFM may contact a supplier when the submitted category, coverage, documents, or capability match a current or future requirement.

Supplier Support

## Submit your supplier profile for PSFM review

Share your company information, category, coverage cities, and available documents so PSFM can review your profile for relevant facility management and project support requirements.

# Suppliers

## Doing business with IHG

IHG is committed to working with suppliers that best meet the needs of our organisation, our owners, our brands, our hotels, and our guests. We aim to work with suppliers who are amongst the leaders in their fields, and we have divided our supplier base into four broad procurement areas:

* Marketing (Advertising, Media, PR, Fulfilment, Print, Research, Events and Sponsorships)
* Hotel (Food, Beverage, Consumables, Engineering and Hotel Utilities)
* Corporate (Legal, Consultancy, Human Resources, and Travel)
* Global Technology (Hardware and Software)

## A message from IHG’s Chief Procurement Officer

At IHG, we value our relationships with global, regional, and local suppliers. We strive to develop strategic relationships that add significant value and innovation across our brands and regions. IHG is committed to responsible procurement and actively works with suppliers who share our values.

**Prospective partners**

We invite all prospective partners to register their interest in working with us. Please note that the completion of the supplier registration is not an approval for doing business with IHG. It does not guarantee that your company will receive an RFx, request for bid, or contract from IHG. Completing the supplier registration does not imply that your company has any procurement relationship with IHG, either now or in the future.

The supplier registration file provides key information about your company to internal IHG procurement groups. Please update any outdated or incorrect information in your registration as needed. If your registration has not been accessed for two years (i.e., no updates or changes), it is subject to deletion.

Thank you for your continued support. We look forward to continuing to develop relationships across all business areas.

**Invoice related queries**

As a supplier already doing business with IHG, you can contact the respective IHG team below with any invoice-related matters.

* ASIA - [email protected]
* EMEA - [email protected]
* AMER - [email protected]

For any invoice queries (global), please contact: [email protected]

awardAndSupplementaryPages.title: Red Sea Global awards major infrastructure contract worth nearly SAR one billion for Amaala
awardAndSupplementaryPages.description: Saudi-based AL-AYUNI Investment and Contracting Company appointed to progress development at Amaala’s first phase of development across its Triple Bay masterplan

children.text: Saudi-based AL-AYUNI Investment and Contracting Company appointed to progress development at Amaala’s first phase of development across its Triple Bay masterplan

Riyadh, 16 January, 2023: Red Sea Global (RSG), the multi-project developer behind the world’s most ambitious regenerative tourism destinations, The Red Sea and Amaala, has awarded a Primary Infrastructure and Utility Contract valued at nearly SAR one billion. The project will be undertaken by AL-AYUNI Investment and Contracting Company to deliver the first phase of development at Amaala, an ultra-luxury tourism destination located along the Kingdom’s north-western coast, across its Triple Bay masterplan.

AL-AYUNI, classified as a “First Class” contractor in the Kingdom since 2006, will be responsible for delivering state-of-the-art Primary Utility Infrastructure Systems, while minimizing Triple Bay’s carbon footprint as part of Amaala’s commitment towards net-zero operations.

AL-AYUNI was selected based on its overall technical and commercial competencies, as well as regional and global credentials. All design and construction methods meet RSG’s stringent criteria for end-to-end sustainable development, including economic, financial, social, and institutional factors.

Faheed Al-Ayuni Chairman of AL-AYUNI Investment and Contracting Company said: “Red Sea Global is a future-forward developer that is closely aligned with our legacy of innovating world-class solutions, cementing trusted relationships, and setting new benchmarks. It is an honor for us to contribute to its pioneering destinations and we look forward to unlocking the full breadth of our robust capabilities to meet RSG’s ambitious sustainability targets.”

Amaala’s first phase of development, focused on the Triple Bay masterplan, will encompass eight hotels and upwards of 1,200 hotel keys, upon full completion in 2027, the destination will offer 3,000 hotel rooms across 25 hotels as well as high-end retail establishments, fine dining, wellness, and recreational facilities.

children.text: Red Sea Global awards SALCO the landscape contract for Rosewood at AMAALA
Red Sea Global appointed SALCO to deliver the softscape works for the Rosewood Hotels and Resorts property at Triple Bay, covering the outdoor areas of the resort and its branded residences.
The award was announced on 10 August 2023. Red Sea Global, the developer behind both The Red Sea and AMAALA, said it chose SALCO for its record in delivering outdoor spaces at scale.

The scope covers the outdoor areas of the property, worked to a design concept meant to give guests a landscape that holds its own against the coast it sits on. The developer described the intent as creating oases that sit naturally within the surrounding environment rather than being imposed on it.
What SALCO brings to it

Founded in 1982, SALCO works across external works, site development, infrastructure, utilities, landscape and irrigation. At the time of the award the company employed around 1,500 people and had delivered more than SAR 2 billion of projects over the preceding five years.

SALCO’s chief executive, Yehya Kreidieh, described the partnership as driven by “a common vision of excellence, sustainability, and environmental stewardship”. Fahad Al-Balawi, head of construction at AMAALA, said the appointment covered the softscape works and pointed to the same shared commitment to sustainability.
